narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I will pick even digits adding to nine, the smallest digit sum.
<bookmark mark='try'/>Four and four give eight, and four and six give ten. They skip nine.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Even digits always add to an even number, and nine is odd.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, see that every digit is even and that nine divides the number.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>Fix the digit sum first, then the fewest digits, then the smallest digits.

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu looks for even digits adding to nine. Even digits always add to an even number, and nine is odd, so no such digits exist.
